en.purpose: To assess the prognostic stage group for endometrial cancer.
en.misuse: Not to be used to record the staging for other gynecological cancers.

other_details.en: An assessment tool used to assign the prognostic stage group for endometrial cancer according to the FIGO 2009 staging system.
other_details.references:
